body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_n\), first express all perturbation bounds through \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}=\inf_{(i,t)\in G\times W}\sigma_r(M^{it})\). The native and neighborhood-replaced fits satisfy \(|(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\Delta^{\mathrm{aux}}_{it}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), and the native estimator obeys \((gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})=L+Q+R_{\mathrm{agg}}\), where \(|Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4/(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\sqrt n))\), \(|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n)\), \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{\log n/m}+\log n/m+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}^2)\), \(|\widehat B_2-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+\Delta_\gamma/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}})\), and \(\sum_i\|\widehat w_{i\cdot}-w_{i\cdot}\|_2^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2)\). The term \(R_{\mathrm{agg}}\) contains the cubic, penalty, and native-transfer components fixed by its definition. Since \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\le\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\le\psi\), substitution changes only constants. Under \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), the corresponding remainder-to-standard-error ratios are bounded by terms of orders \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), \(\ell_n^4n\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2\), \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/n\), and \(\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), all \(o_{\mathbb P}(1)\).
body.justification: This is the unresolved bridge from a target-specific, conditionally independent neighborhood-replaced proof device to second-order inference for the native masked optimizer.
body.gap: Choi, Kwon, and Liao prove first-order auxiliary equivalence under independent noise, while Choi and Yuan prove neighborhood deletion for fully observed PCA; neither controls this centered aggregate through a masked proximal map.
body.consumer: The theorem certifies that feasible correction and studentization can be applied to the estimator already used for the SEC Tick Size Pilot panel.

obligation.what_is_open: A uniform second-order expansion of the implemented masked nuclear-norm fixed point, including centered quadratic aggregation, cubic and penalty terms, absolute curvature plug-in stability, pretreatment reconstruction, and relative fitted-weight consistency.
obligation.obstruction: The exact proximal identity supplies only a self-consistent nonsmooth map. The frozen assumptions do not yet yield a proved simultaneous active-rank neighborhood, a quantitative contraction for all shared-data local fits, or concentration of the aggregate overlapping quadratic forms. Pointwise projector Taylor expansion does not imply the asserted signed aggregate rates.
obligation.attempted: Reduced the optimizer to its exact singular-value-thresholding fixed point, derived the full tangent, conditioned through the neighborhood-replaced fit, and converted each asserted raw rate to the oracle standard-error scale. Nonexpansiveness alone loses the averaging gain and does not control regularization or Hessian plug-in error.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved proximal identity reduces every local convex fit to the actual self-consistent map
\[
 A\longmapsto\operatorname{SVT}_{\lambda}\!\left(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}Y^{\mathrm{obs}}+P_{(\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it})^c}A\right),
\]
the complete first differential is the declared three-term score, and the auxiliary fit has the required target-coordinate conditional separation.  If the raw bounds asserted in the target theorem are established, their oracle-scale implication is already deterministic.  Indeed \(s\ge c(nH)^{-1/2}\) and \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\ge c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\) give
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{|Q-B_2|}{s}&=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}}\right),\\
 \frac{|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|}{s}
 & =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2}+\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{n}\right),\\
 \frac{|\widehat B_2-B_2|}{s}
 & =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2}+\frac{\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}}\right).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Under \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), the first three displayed deterministic factors are respectively at most constant multiples of
\[
 n^{-1/2-\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^{-4},
 \qquad n^{-2\eta}\ell_n^{-12},
 \qquad \ell_n^4\sqrt H/n,
\]
and hence vanish because \(H\le Cn\).  Moreover the asserted reconstruction rate and \(m\asymp n\) would give \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2n^{-1/2})\), making the covariance term vanish as well.  What remains unproved is precisely the native-optimizer source of those raw bounds and the relative fitted-weight bound.
